jobs.company: Seguridad Pública — Provincia de Buenos Aires
jobs.position: Tech Lead · Full Stack & DevOps Engineer — Criminal Intelligence (ICIA)
description: Designed and developed ICIA (Infraestructura de Inteligencia Criminal y Analítica), a complete ecosystem of 13 interconnected systems for criminal data analysis and public security of Buenos Aires Province

Built Hermes, a criminal intelligence web platform with interactive dashboards for homicides (HOBA), armed confrontations, stolen vehicles, and police procedures — using Next.js, TypeScript, Chart.js, Leaflet heat maps, and multi-field filters with CSV/Excel/PDF export

Developed Prometheus, Quiron, Cassandra, and Pegasus: a suite of Python/FastAPI microservices for loading, deep analysis, and querying of criminal incidents with role-based access control and paginated shared API layer

Engineered Argo + Argonauta, a distributed master-slave bot architecture using FastAPI, WebSockets, and Selenium to automate extraction of judicial records from police systems, with real-time web console and Excel output pipeline

Built Teseo, an intelligence system for football security risk management (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/CRITICAL) with geolocated incidents, club conflict ranking, gang intelligence, and versioned operational plan generation

Deployed Cerberus (centralized JWT auth with multi-role system and rate limiting), Helios (async activity logging microservice), Ariadna (desktop SISEP data processor with integrity pipeline to MySQL), and Hestia (custom Docker container monitor)
Developed web applications using MVVM architecture pattern with Vue.js and React frameworks
Built responsive user interfaces with HTML5, CSS3, and modern JavaScript ES6+
Implemented RESTful APIs using Node.js and Express.js with PostgreSQL and MongoDB databases
Maintained and optimized existing applications improving performance by 30%
Collaborated with remote teams using Git version control and agile methodologies
Integrated third-party APIs and services for enhanced application functionality
